caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a human figure from the chest upward, set against a plain, light-colored background. The head appears to be made of a light brown or tan material, with dark, prominent eyebrows and large, wide-open eyes featuring well-defined irises and pupils. The lips are outlined and slightly reddish. The hair is dark brown or black, short, and combed back. The figure is dressed in a dark brown, possibly black jacket with a high collar, and the garment appears stylized, with exaggerated, rounded shoulders and a pronounced swirl or scroll pattern on the left breast area. The material of the clothing appears textured and includes subtle highlights of yellow. The lower edge of the bust is curved and unfinished, with an irregular, organic shape that cuts off below the chest. There are no additional objects or backgrounds in the composition.
title: Figurehead
